bib.title: LLaMA-Adapter V2: Parameter-Efficient Visual Instruction Model

read.skipped: none; reference list skimmed. Figures 10-11 are images.

question: Can a frozen LLaMA be turned into an open-ended visual instruction model with few trainable parameters and no multi-modal instruction data?
hypothesis: Early fusion of visual tokens plus joint training of disjoint parameter groups on captions and text instructions removes the interference between image-text alignment and instruction following.
contributions: Stronger language instruction model via bias tuning and high-quality instruction data, with multi-turn dialog
Balanced visual instruction tuning by early fusion, without multi-modal instruction data
Integration of expert systems (caption, OCR) at inference

method.summary: Starts from LLaMA-Adapter (zero-init gated prompts in a frozen LLaMA). Adds learnable norm, bias and scale in every linear layer (y = s(Wx+b)), injects visual tokens only at the first layer, and trains two disjoint parameter groups on COCO captions and GPT-4-LLM instructions. At inference a caption or OCR expert adds a text context.
method.task: visual instruction tuning (parameter-efficient) and language instruction following

datasets.name: ShareGPT conversations
datasets.split: used for the chatbot variant only

models.name: LLaMA-Adapter V2
models.architecture: frozen LLaMA with zero-init gated adaptation prompts, early visual prompts, bias and scale tuning
models.init_from: LLaMA (7B for the implementation details; 65B for chat and GPT-4 comparison)

other.adaptation_prompt_layers: last 31 of 32 for 7B (text also says L=30 as an example)
other.visual_prompt: concatenated at first layer, prompt length 20
other.visual_encoder: CLIP-style pre-trained encoder, frozen (version not stated)
other.optional: LoRA in place of bias tuning

models.name: LLaMA-Adapter
models.architecture: zero-init attention adapters in higher layers

other.disjoint_groups: caption data trains only visual projection layers and early zero-init attention with gating; instruction data trains late adaptation prompts with zero gating, unfrozen norms, new bias and scale (or optional LoRA)

inference.prompting: Visual context + question -> short answer; question + textual context -> detailed answer; optional expert caption/OCR text as textual context

other.caption_expert: LLaMA-Adapter V1 trained on COCO Caption

metrics.name: GPT-4 total quality score vs ChatGPT
metrics.definition: GPT-4 scores responses to 80 questions; ratio to ChatGPT total

eval.protocol: Single runs; GPT-4 judge on 80 questions; visual understanding shown with qualitative examples only; no VQA benchmark.

limits: No visual QA or multimodal benchmark score; visual instruction ability shown only by hand-picked examples (Figs 6-9).
Failure on out-of-distribution (cartoon) image, attributed to lack of image-text alignment stage.
Lags LLaVA in visual understanding; sensitive to wrong expert output.
No optimizer, lr, batch size, epochs, hardware or seeds reported.
Chat quality judged by GPT-4 on 80 questions; V2 is 65B-based vs 13B Vicuna.
Table 1 counts data and tuning parameters needed from pretrained LLM, including Vicuna's own ShareGPT tuning in MiniGPT-4 row (the paper does not spell out why MiniGPT-4 is 13B).
